newsitem.title: USA: Ford Motor Co consolidates media buying.
newsitem.headline: Ford Motor Co consolidates media buying.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said Tuesday it is consolidating national media buying for its U.S. operations through an agency buying organization called Ford Motor Media.
The new organization is a wholly owned subsidiary of WPP Group Plc's J. Walter Thompson USA, which becomes Ford Motor Company's agency of record for national media, Ford said.
The unit will be led by David Ropes, Ford's director of corporate advertising and integrated marketing, Ford said.

Ford Motor Media will be housed in metropolitan Detroit. It will be dedicated exclusively to buying national media for participating Ford units, which include Ford Division, Lincoln-Mercury Division, Ford Customer Service Division, Ford Corporate Advertising and Jaguar North America, as well as Mazda Motors of America, Ford said.
